probe_finding: Definition (author @throwthedamball, read 2026-10-15): PERFECT BLOCK RATE — the share of an offense's plays on which NO offensive lineman blows his assignment, charted with the EPA on those plays. It measures the clean-play environment a QB actually works in, as opposed to the pressure outcomes that environment produces. Role in-engine: an offensive-line integrity primitive — it sits upstream of pressure rate (a line can allow few pressures while still breaking assignments the QB bails out), so reads about QB performance under 'clean' conditions should know whether the pockets were assignment-clean or QB-rescued.
